gen-gf-snowburst-one-plus-jakarta-sans: Wide stencil bridges slice through the tall letters of Snowburst One, like a cut sheet. Plus Jakarta Sans draws a single-weight line with curve endings held well apart, and that restraint is what makes the pair work.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-sora: Loud, tall and stencil-cut, Snowburst One leaves wide bridges between its letters. And Sora, with no pressure swell on its curves, gives that tall loudness a moderate, precise counterweight.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-plein: Plein gives every round letter a clear channel in, reliable and clean. Plein sits quietly beneath Tektur, whose pipe-cleaner strokes of unvarying width and outsized lowercase do the shouting.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-roundo: Roundo keeps its n tidy, arch and stem matching, with small counters that never clog. But after Tektur, with its pipe-cleaner strokes and outsized lowercase, paragraphs would glide by without a snag.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-synonym: Synonym lays down a plain stripe of constant ink, its curves opening generously, clean and dependable beside Tektur. Tektur earns its keep when the words are big and brief.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe: Alumni Sans Pinstripe packs words into a tight texture, with oversized lowercase standing beside small capitals. Alumni Sans Pinstripe would carry paragraphs with rope-like curves, a friendly hum under Tektur.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-anaheim: Tektur looks like bent pipe-cleaner, generously open at every curve ending. Anaheim, a rounded sans whose lowercase fills the line like capitals, rewards a slightly larger size than usual.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-geom: Geom carries a lofty lowercase band, contemporary and quietly approachable. Against Tektur, whose single unbroken line runs from terminals to junctions, Geom is the tall, steady voice that makes the pair work.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-inder: Expressive and distinctive, Tektur is all tubular, wire-like letterforms. Inder, clean and professional with little height difference between cases, gives Tektur a low-key partner that stays out of the way.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Tektur is expressive, with pipe-cleaner strokes and outsized lowercase letters. Kdam Thmor Pro, a contemporary sans whose bowls fill the line, would carry paragraphs with a modern, easy rhythm.
